title: Sing When You're Winning — RECEIPT Ontology Amendment: Broad Anchor vs Outcome-Bearing Receipt
triggering_falsification_pressure: Provenance-verified chronophotography and multiflash motion studies can contain the same physical subject repeated in one coherent world together with one salient action, ball, tool, camera, or event anchor. Under the original broad RECEIPT wording ('object/event/anchor'), such works can reproduce the full SOURCE -> WORLD -> RECEIPT chain without containing a unique external result or fulfillment token. This is a legitimate challenge to the original broad anomaly formulation and must not be hidden by silently narrowing RECEIPT after seeing the controls.

RECEIPT_BROAD_ANCHOR_LEGACY.definition: One salient external object, event, action, or scene anchor whose counted instance remains singular despite multiple visible representations of the source.
examples_that_may_pass: one ball in a multiflash swing
one camera in a mirror self-portrait
one club or one motion episode in a stroboscopic study
one shared meal or one scene-level object
RECEIPT_BROAD_ANCHOR_LEGACY.interpretive_limit: A pass means only that an external anchor is singular. It does not mean a completed outcome, authorization, victory, fulfillment, or transaction exists.

RECEIPT_OUTCOME_BEARING.definition: One externally grounded result, fulfillment, authorization, achievement, transaction effect, ownership/status transition, or outcome-bearing token that certifies or embodies a completed world-level consequence and remains singular despite source multiplicity.
pass_examples: one championship trophy functioning as the result token of one victory
one signed transaction receipt for one payment
fail_examples: a ball that is only an object in an action sequence
a club or tool with no completion/status semantics
an ongoing motion episode without a result-bearing external token
RECEIPT_OUTCOME_BEARING.important_rule: Outcome-bearing status must not be inferred solely because an object is visually central. Context/provenance must establish result or fulfillment semantics.

CHAIN_LEGACY_BROAD.anti_rescue_rule: If this chain is common among matched controls, the original broad hypothesis is weakened or falsified even if the newer outcome-bearing chain remains rare.

CHAIN_OUTCOME_RECEIPT.anti_rescue_rule: It must not be retroactively substituted for CHAIN_LEGACY_BROAD when describing the earlier experiment.

target_classification.object: Robbie Williams — Sing When You're Winning artwork
target_classification.outcome_type: football victory / trophy as achievement token
target_classification.caution: The semantic role of the trophy as victory outcome is visually strong, but confirmatory scoring must be applied identically to controls.

harold_edgerton_multiflash_golf.reason: One moving athlete is registered repeatedly in one scene and the golf action/ball supplies a singular external anchor, but the photograph does not by itself certify a championship or completed external status transition.

etienne_jules_marey_chronophotography.reason: Successive phases of one physical action are superimposed or sequenced around one task/action without an outcome-bearing receipt.

ilse_bing_self_portrait_with_mirrors.reason: The camera/mirror scene can satisfy a broad unique-object anchor but not a completed external result.

paul_m_smith_and_kelli_connell_multiple_.reason: These works are strong physical-source and one-world controls; whether they pass the legacy broad anchor depends on the frozen individual image, while they generally lack a canonical result-bearing receipt.

why_this_matters_beyond_visual_art.distributed_systems: A shared object is not necessarily a committed side effect. Distinguish a resource reference/anchor from an authoritative transaction receipt.
why_this_matters_beyond_visual_art.multi_agent_ai: Multiple agent views may point at one task object without proving that the task was fulfilled exactly once. Outcome receipts must bind to actual external completion.
why_this_matters_beyond_visual_art.databases: A row/key reference is not equivalent to a committed transaction. The distinction mirrors prepared/intended state versus committed state.
why_this_matters_beyond_visual_art.payments: Seeing one payment target is not equivalent to possessing one settlement receipt.
why_this_matters_beyond_visual_art.games_and_simulations: A ball, boss, or objective is an anchor; a server-authoritative win/loot grant is an outcome receipt.
why_this_matters_beyond_visual_art.identity_and_authority: A shared badge/object does not prove one authoritative decision or fulfillment event.

null_policy: Use null when image/provenance cannot establish whether an object is unique or whether it carries completion/outcome semantics. Never upgrade salience to outcome status by interpretation alone.

decision_logic.original_hypothesis_supported: CHAIN_LEGACY_BROAD is rare in a preregistered matched control sample.
decision_logic.original_hypothesis_weakened: CHAIN_LEGACY_BROAD recurs commonly among same-physical-subject one-world controls.
decision_logic.new_outcome_hypothesis_supported: CHAIN_OUTCOME_RECEIPT remains rare after the outcome definition is frozen and independently scored.
decision_logic.new_outcome_hypothesis_falsified: Comparable same-subject one-world compositions frequently contain one outcome-bearing receipt under the same rules.

claim_ceiling: The split is an ontology repair prompted by adversarial controls. It may weaken the original broad anomaly. It is not evidence for a special mechanism and cannot be used as a post-hoc rescue of the Robbie interpretation.

versioning.future_changes: require explicit new version; CHAIN_LEGACY_BROAD remains historically immutable
